tasks.short: Develop or modify industrial electronic equipment

steps.what: Interpret specifications and develop the required electronic device or circuit modification
Modify the device or circuit and check the resulting electrical behaviour

tasks.design: Retain specification interpretation and physical development with the repairer. Existing reference material in {DOCS} supports the work; no generated circuit or automated hardware change is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Practical development depends on real interfaces, constraints and component behaviour.
tasks.enabler_now: Work-order tools do not establish reliable circuit development.
tasks.still_hard: A nominally correct circuit may fail under load or real operating conditions.
tasks.human_edge: The repairer relates specifications to actual equipment and verifies behaviour.
tasks.altitude: No change in development effort or release authority.

evidence.claim: Specification interpretation and physical modification remain skilled work; the digest provides no demonstrated circuit-development saving.

assumptions: Boundary is the repairer's design contribution, modification and verification, excluding formal engineering release and subsequent production use.
Engineering supplies existing specifications upstream with unchanged effort. No machine step requires newly structured inputs.
No implementation or additional upkeep is introduced; incremental effort is zero.
research_questions: Which modifications require engineering approval before physical work starts?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 and zero upkeep; all actual development and verification effort is retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assess standard equipment or specify additional functions

steps.what: Determine feasibility of standard equipment against required functions, interfaces and operating constraints
Develop equipment specifications for the additional functions and explain unresolved assumptions

tasks.design: Keep feasibility assessment and functional specification development with the repairer using {DOCS}. No product-data extraction or specification formatting share is assumed without observing it separately.
tasks.previous_blocker: Feasibility depends on interfaces and operating conditions beyond catalogue labels.
tasks.enabler_now: Searchable specifications do not prove suitability for additional functions.
tasks.still_hard: Unstated environmental, load and control requirements can invalidate an option.
tasks.human_edge: The repairer identifies missing requirements and practical incompatibilities.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in feasibility judgement or specification authority.

evidence.claim: Technical feasibility and functional specification remain judgement work; no clerical workload is inferred from the word specification.

assumptions: Boundary is assessment and a specification proposal, excluding procurement, detailed design and formal release.
Requesting staff supply existing functional needs and manufacturers supply existing specifications upstream with unchanged effort. The repairer resolves missing details within retained s1.
No machine step or new deployment is introduced; upkeep is zero.
research_questions: Which feasibility decisions depend on site inspection rather than document comparison?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 and zero upkeep. Assessment and specification development remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise management on performance and improvements

steps.what: Advise management about customer satisfaction, product performance and practical product improvements

tasks.design: Keep the repairer's advice and discussion with management. Existing service records in {DOCS} can support the conversation, but no reporting duty or new summary is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Field experience needs contextual explanation and challenge.
tasks.enabler_now: Work-order recaps do not substitute for the repairer's recommendations.
tasks.still_hard: A few complaints may not represent overall product performance.
tasks.human_edge: The repairer distinguishes practical patterns from isolated incidents.
tasks.altitude: No change in advisory time or management decision rights.

evidence.claim: Management advice remains a contextual discussion; a work-order recap capability alone does not establish less advisory effort.

assumptions: Boundary is advice from existing service experience, excluding service-record creation and management implementation.
Customer feedback and service observations already arise in the repairer's work; no newly coded satisfaction data or machine step is assumed.
No new tool or ongoing upkeep is introduced; incremental hours are zero.
unknowns: Form of advice and actual reporting responsibilities
research_questions: Does the repairer prepare a separate recurring report that should be scoped independently?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 and zero upkeep. No change to contextual advice yields zero saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Send defective equipment for specialist repair

steps.what: Confirm the defective unit, repair destination and return authorisation details
Prepare return paperwork and address labels from the confirmed repair details
Check the unit and paperwork, pack it and hand it over for specialist repair

tasks.design: Configure a native {DOCS} form to reuse confirmed unit and destination details for return paperwork and labels. The repairer checks the exact unit and papers before packing and dispatching it.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same unit and recipient details are typed on several return documents.
tasks.enabler_now: Document fields can render several forms from one confirmed entry.
tasks.still_hard: Repair authorisation, packaging and physical unit identity require checking.
tasks.human_edge: The repairer confirms that the right defective unit goes to the right specialist.
tasks.altitude: Less repeat paperwork; physical handling and dispatch responsibility remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Rendering return paperwork from captured fields is plausible; no digest case measures this specialist-return task or its savings.

assumptions: Boundary is repairer preparation through carrier handoff, excluding transit and specialist repair; those actors' effort remains unchanged.

Repairer captures asset ID, serial number, fault description, provider, return authorisation, street, postcode, locality and country in s1's full 30 hours. Repair provider supplies the authorised destination during that retained contact. Missing address fields or unusual forms use manual paperwork in s3.
Test native document forms before custom code. Capture time is retained and additional template upkeep is counted.
unknowns: Provider-specific return forms and packaging rules
research_questions: Does one verified capture populate all required return forms without extra preparation effort?

already_counted.description: Return authorisation and structured detail capture

incremental.description: Maintain provider forms and address-field mappings

approvals.approved_version: Exact unit serial, return authorisation, destination and paperwork version; changes require fresh dispatch checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=80; gross 20 less 4 upkeep gives net 16. Low assumes paperwork already generated and no change deployed; high requires 20 hours of actual repeat form entry. Packing and transit earn no saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain technical development and advice while reducing repeated specialist-return paperwork where it exists.
reach: Help supervisors trace specialist repair returns
Coordinate equipment modification requirements with mechanics
role.ambitious_version: A repairer who keeps technical judgement and physical handling while avoiding repeated form entry.
